# Import Fidelity & Secrets Checklist: Import Postman v3

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements, for a reviewer before implementation. They check that v3 → Xenon
mapping, detection precedence, ordering, cross-platform behaviour and secret handling are complete, clear,
consistent and measurable.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`, then **run**. Every item was evaluated against the artifacts.

- Items that failed on the first run were fixed in the artifacts before ticking; they are marked *(fixed)*.
- The answer clause says what makes each item pass.

## Requirement Completeness — mapping

- [x] CHK001 Are mapping requirements defined for every v3 request field the CLI emits (`url`, `method`, `headers`,
  `queryParams`, `pathVariables`, `body`, `auth`, `scripts`, `settings`, `description`, `examples`, `id`, `name`)?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-015] The Request table in contracts/v3-to-v21-mapping.md lists each one. The key
  list comes from the redacted survey of 12 real collections (research R1).
- [x] CHK002 Are mapping requirements defined for every v3 body type, including `none` and unknown keys on `body`?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-010] The contract's Body table covers json/text/xml/html/javascript, formdata,
  urlencoded, graphql, file and none, and says other keys are copied.
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for both shapes of headers and credentials (list and map)? [Completeness,
  Spec §US2-3, §FR-011] The contract "Normalisation" section and FR-011 cover both. Both shapes were observed in
  real output (research R1).
- [x] CHK004 Is the auth mapping defined at all three levels, including inherit, `noauth` and unsupported types?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-011] FR-011, the contract Auth table, and the Edge Cases entry on unsupported types.
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for multi-auth lists with one entry and with more than one? [Completeness,
  Spec §Clarifications, §FR-011] The user decided: the first entry is used and a warning names the rest. The
  contract fixes the list passthrough `postmanV3.auth`.
- [x] CHK006 Are script-type mappings defined for request, collection and folder, and for GraphQL requests, with
  protocol-only scripts handled explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012] FR-012 and the contract Scripts table.
  `graphql:*`/`grpc:*` scripts are kept for export with a `protocol_script` warning.
- [x] CHK007 Are example mappings defined for both inline JSON examples and YAML example files, including how a
  request finds its examples? [Completeness, Spec §US1-5, §US2-2] The contract Example table, research R12, and the
  `examples` path rule added to the contract Request row.
- [x] CHK008 Are variable mappings defined at collection, folder and request level? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
  FR-013 plus Edge Cases. Folder and request variables carry the v2.1 warnings.
- [x] CHK009 Is the fate of every v3 field Xenon cannot represent specified, so that none is dropped silently?
  [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018] FR-018 plus research R6: unknown keys are copied into the v2.1 document
  and kept by passthrough. FR-017 and R8: each lossy case has a warning.
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for non-HTTP request kinds, including kinds Postman may add later?
  [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases] *(fixed)* Any `$kind` ending in `-request` that Xenon does not support is skipped
  with the `unsupported_request_type` warning (spec Edge Cases, research R9, contract).

## Requirement Clarity — detection & ordering

- [x] CHK011 Is the detection precedence between v3 and existing formats stated unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec
  §FR-007] FR-007 and research R4. The v3 rules run after the Xenon, dump and Bruno checks.
- [x] CHK012 Are the folder signals for a workspace and for a single collection disjoint and exhaustive?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005] FR-003 excludes FR-005 matches. *(fixed)* FR-005 now lists `globals/` and the
  "folder named `collections`" rule, consistent with research R4.1.
- [x] CHK013 Is the environment-vs-globals rule fully specified for YAML, local JSON and cloud JSON? [Clarity,
  Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006] *(fixed)* The spec rule now includes the `id` ending in `.globals.yaml` signal. That
  matches research R5 and the real CLI output.
- [x] CHK014 Is sibling ordering defined deterministically, including missing and duplicate `order` and the JSON
  case? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases] The rule is `order` ascending, then missing, ties by case-folded name; JSON uses
  array order (research R10).
- [x] CHK015 Are naming fallbacks defined for collection, folder, request, example and environment? [Clarity, Spec
  §US2-1, §US3-1] Research R11 covers all five.
- [x] CHK016 Is the version and kind reported for each v3 source specified exactly? [Clarity, Spec §US5-1]
  contracts/import-service.md, Detect table.
- [x] CHK017 Is pasted-text detection scoped explicitly? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases "Pasted text"] JSON only. YAML
  gets the generic error.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK018 Do the malformed-file requirements agree across spec, research and tasks? [Consistency, Spec §Edge
  Cases] *(fixed)* Spec, R4.5 and R9 now agree:
  - v3-named or in-folder files give `IMP-11400`;
  - other YAML gives the generic error.
- [x] CHK019 Are warning codes and messages consistent between spec, research R8, the contract and the BDD tasks?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-017] The R8 table is the single source. Tasks T024, T030, T037 and T043 quote the same
  messages.
- [x] CHK020 Is the "same fidelity as v2.1" claim consistent with how equality is measured? [Consistency, Spec
  §SC-001] Research R14 defines the canonical v2.1 fixture form. *(fixed)* The contract drops empty `settings`
  values, so passthrough cannot differ by an empty `protocolProfileBehavior`.
- [x] CHK021 Are new kinds named consistently across spec, data-model, contract, frontend labels and tasks?
  [Consistency] `postman_request` and `postman_workspace` appear identically in data-model, import-service.md,
  plan, T011 and T049.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 Can SC-001 ("equal apart from ids") be measured objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] Yes. The
  existing step compares bytes after ULID replacement (`then_file_compare_steps_test.go:33`), on fixtures built per
  R14.
- [x] CHK023 Is SC-003 ("no secret value anywhere") measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] Yes. Fixture secret
  strings are distinct (`s3cr3t-fixture-*`) and asserted absent with `no file under the workspace folder should
  contain` and `the log output should not contain`.
- [x] CHK024 Is SC-006 quantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006] Yes: the existing bound of detect < 2000 ms,
  import < 8000 ms and progress ≤ 250 ms (T053, from `large_collection.feature`).
- [x] CHK025 Does every acceptance scenario in US1–US5 trace to a BDD task? [Traceability] Yes: the plan's BDD
  Coverage table and tasks T024/T025, T030/T031, T037/T038, T043–T045 and T051.

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are exception flows defined for a broken file inside a multi-item source? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
  *(fixed)* The spec Edge Case "One broken file in a workspace folder" refuses the whole source at detect, as for a
  dump. T043(7) covers it.
- [x] CHK027 Is the empty or non-importable `postman/` folder case defined? [Coverage, Edge Case] *(fixed)* The spec
  Edge Case gives the generic error. T043(8) covers it.
- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for importing a single request with and without a parent target? [Coverage,
  Spec §US2-4, §FR-004] Into a folder: allowed with its examples. Top level: refused with `IMP-35400`.
- [x] CHK029 Is clash behaviour for v3 items defined, including globals merges and per-item workspace items?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-023, §US3-4, §US4-2] The service is format-agnostic (research, data-model). Covered by
  T024(15), T037 and T043(2).
- [x] CHK030 Are duplicate sibling names in a v3 collection addressed? [Coverage, Edge Case] *(fixed)* The spec Edge
  Case says they are handled as for v2.1, by the existing de-duplication.
- [x] CHK031 Is recovery or rollback defined if writing fails mid-import? [Coverage, Recovery] FR-024 keeps the
  existing per-item atomic writes. Vault rollback on save failure is the existing behaviour
  (`import_variables_writer`).
- [x] CHK032 Is the repository-folder pick scoped so that unrelated files cannot affect the import? [Coverage,
  Spec §US4-4, §FR-022] Only `postman/` is read (research R4). T043(4) proves it with a non-UTF-8 file outside it.

## Non-Functional — Secrets & data handling

- [x] CHK033 Are all secret sources enumerated: environment, globals, collection variables, CLI-masked and
  vault-linked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019, §FR-020] FR-016, FR-019, FR-020 and research R7.
- [x] CHK034 Is every sink a secret must not reach named: workspace files, logs, console, preview, warnings,
  errors, fixtures and commits? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Constitution II]
  - FR-019 names files, logs, console and preview.
  - The plan's constitution gate covers fixtures and commits.
  - *(fixed)* Errors: the `IMP-11400` reason never quotes content (research R9, T028 unit test, T030(14)).
- [x] CHK035 Is it specified that the CLI mask `********` is never stored as a value, for every scope?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §US3-3] Environments and globals are covered by FR-020. *(fixed)* The contract now applies
  the mask rule to collection variables too.
- [x] CHK036 Is it specified which vault-link data may appear in output and which may not? [Clarity, Spec §Edge
  Cases] Secret and vault ids may appear in the warning; no value exists to leak.
- [x] CHK037 Is the routing of collection-variable secrets into the vault specified, including import into an
  existing collection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019] Research R7: the scope is the new collection id, or the target
  collection for parent placement, through the existing `keepCollectionSecrets`.
- [x] CHK038 Is the deliberate change to v2.1 behaviour (secret collection variables go to the vault) documented
  and justified? [Consistency, Constitution II] Plan, Complexity Tracking, and research R7. It has its own scenario
  (T025). No existing fixture is affected (verified by grep).
- [x] CHK039 Are fixture rules stated so no real secret can land in the repo? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions,
  Constitution II] Spec Assumptions and research R14 use fake values only. The real CLI samples stayed in the
  session scratchpad and are not fixtures.

## Non-Functional — Cross-platform

- [x] CHK040 Are cross-platform requirements stated for ordering, separators and file names? [Coverage,
  Constitution VII] Plan gate VII (case-folded sort, `filepath`/`ToSlash`, Windows-illegal names through `name:`)
  and T002.
- [x] CHK041 Is the `examples` path format defined portably? [Clarity] *(fixed)* The contract says it is relative to
  the request file, uses `/`, and `./` and a trailing `/` are optional.
